name: Native physiological contribution and its conditions
description: Represent which cellular/organismal consequence an activity contributes to in biological context, preserving environmental, nutrient, temporal and population conditions.
claim_scope: A gene/activity in a stated strain, environment, phase and outcome, with coexisting roles retained; measured capacity need not be dominant native function.
distinctions: Immediate regrowth versus long-term survival or competition.
Nutrient use versus detoxification, fitness or protection.
Additional conditional role versus erasing prior valid roles.

example_structured_values.meaning: Finite examples of declared values/reference types, not a complete ontology, numerical credit scale, adopted scoring axis or claim of existing runtime compatibility.

not_established: One model/time window is not universal role.
Reporter is not flux; population association is not lineage-tracked fate.
No early growth defect does not exclude later survival contribution.
Side activity/heterologous rescue does not establish primary native flux.
boundary: A08 gives biological consequence. A06 assigns system responsibility, A09 dependence given alternatives. Shared context fields are scope, not another library slot.

evidence.source_locator: Trace route_1; recovery/heterogeneity/survival Results; culture/flow Methods; Fig. 6D limitation.
evidence.observation: YeaG loss improves immediate recovery lag but worsens prolonged-starvation survival and changes reporter heterogeneity.
